rear-manifold-mounts.summary: Two rear bolts hold the exhaust casting against the cylinder head before the intake is installed.
rear-manifold-mounts.limits: Ford identifies installation holes15/16. Station coordinates, supporting webs, blind sockets and3/8-16×1.31in comparison dimensions are provisional; the remaining shared clamps are unfinished.

steps.title: Rear casting attaches first
steps.text: The bolt head bears on a casting land; the shaft enters the head socket. The smooth thread envelopes illustrate placement, not retention or clamp load.
